name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace. There is no JavaScript in this repo; these scripts are named entry points for the stdlib-only Python/shell self-checks, so agents, contributors and CI all invoke the same commands. check:ci is what .github/workflows/ci.yml runs, and its check:spec stage holds the two jitter-energy derivations (plain cell and shipped starved cell) and the array sizing to the committed evidence records, while check:regmap holds the interface block's generated Verilog header and pinout document to the one normative register-map table; check:all adds the PDK-dependent checks (the sim stages, plus the schematic-vs-netlist staleness guard), which need ngspice >= 46, xschem and the gf180mcu PDK installed locally.

scripts.lint: python3 -m compileall -q sim design && bash -n sim/selftest.sh
scripts.check:spec: python3 sim/tools/jitter_energy_law.py --check && python3 sim/tools/starved_cell_jitter_energy.py --check && python3 sim/tools/array_sizing.py --check
scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:spec && npm run check:regmap && sim/selftest.sh
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:spec && npm run check:regmap && npm run check:netlist && sim/selftest.sh --require-pdk
